def cases(path,base):
    rows=[];counts=Counter()
    for c in ET.parse(path).getroot().iter('testcase'):
        outcomes=[]
        for e in c:
            if e.tag in ('failure','error','skipped'):
                text=e.text
                if text and text.startswith(str(base)+'/'): text=text[len(str(base))+1:]
                outcomes.append((e.tag,e.attrib,text))
        counts[outcomes[0][1].get('type',outcomes[0][0]) if outcomes else 'passed']+=1
        rows.append((c.get('classname'),c.get('name'),outcomes))
    return rows,counts
